# cmake -S . -B build -DKODI_DEVKIT=<xbmc>/xbmc/addons/kodi-dev-kit/include && cmake --build build --config Release
# -> build/addon/inputstream.startptsrepro/ (copy it into <kodi home>/addons and enable it)
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(inputstream_startptsrepro CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY MultiThreaded) # static CRT: the dev kit's Windows headers clash with the DLL CRT
set(KODI_DEVKIT "" CACHE PATH "kodi-dev-kit/include")
file(STRINGS "${KODI_DEVKIT}/kodi/versions.h" _ver REGEX "^#define ADDON_(GLOBAL|INSTANCE)_VERSION_[A-Z]+(_MIN|_XML_ID)? ")
foreach(l ${_ver})
  if(l MATCHES "^#define (ADDON_[A-Z_]+) +\"([^\"]+)\"")
    set(${CMAKE_MATCH_1} "${CMAKE_MATCH_2}")
  endif()
endforeach()
set(ADDON_DEPENDS "")
foreach(part GLOBAL_VERSION_MAIN GLOBAL_VERSION_GENERAL INSTANCE_VERSION_INPUTSTREAM)
  string(APPEND ADDON_DEPENDS "\n    <import addon=\"${ADDON_${part}_XML_ID}\" minversion=\"${ADDON_${part}_MIN}\" version=\"${ADDON_${part}}\"/>")
endforeach()
if(WIN32)
  set(ADDON_PLATFORM windx)
  set(ADDON_LIBRARY inputstream.startptsrepro.dll)
else()
  set(ADDON_PLATFORM linux)
  set(ADDON_LIBRARY inputstream.startptsrepro.so)
endif()
set(OUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/addon/inputstream.startptsrepro")
configure_file(addon.xml.in "${OUT}/addon.xml" @ONLY)
add_library(inputstream.startptsrepro SHARED main.cpp)
target_include_directories(inputstream.startptsrepro PRIVATE "${KODI_DEVKIT}")
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_definitions(inputstream.startptsrepro PRIVATE NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN)
  target_compile_options(inputstream.startptsrepro PRIVATE /EHsc)
endif()
set_target_properties(inputstream.startptsrepro PROPERTIES PREFIX "" OUTPUT_NAME inputstream.startptsrepro
  RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${OUT}" LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${OUT}"
  RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE "${OUT}" LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE "${OUT}")
